versions.content: {DRAFT} For a Synchronized or Pure Local Time Base if • the Fallback Virtual Local Time is configured (i.e., StbMFallbackTime- Clock is configured) • and the Primary Virtual Local Time is not available • and the Fallback Virtual Local Time is available, when the StbM is required to retrieve the Virtual Local Time , then the StbM shall set the timeBaseStatus bit FALLBACK_TIME_EXTRAPOLATION of the Time Base
